visual.caption: DNS 列舉：從名稱到可驗證的證據
visual.description: 箭頭表示查詢角色或證據判讀順序，不代表每次都接觸權威端，也不代表自動取得存取權；授權須在各階段事先確認。

visual.caption: DNS 的三種機制：效能、資料驗證與傳輸隱私
visual.description: 三張卡片是平行比較。下方箭頭表示簡化查詢路徑；DoH／DoT 保護特定鏈路，DNSSEC 驗證簽章與信任鏈，並非加密整條解析路徑。

items.title: 快取 Cache
items.body: 加速重複查詢：重複請求不必一直問權威 DNS。不能證明特定使用者曾造訪網站。

items.title: DNSSEC
items.body: 驗證經簽署資料的來源與完整性。不能保證查詢內容保密或網站正常。

items.title: 加密 DNS：DoH / DoT
items.body: 保護用戶端到解析服務的特定傳輸鏈路。解析服務仍可得知並處理查詢內容。

items.title: 你的電腦｜Stub Resolver
items.body: 發起 DNS 查詢

items.title: 遞迴解析器
items.body: 可進行 DNSSEC 驗證；也可能使用快取

items.title: 權威 DNS 資料
items.body: 依區域設定提供紀錄

items.title: 用戶端 ↔ 解析服務：DoH / DoT
items.body: 加密這段傳輸鏈路；不保證後續鏈路同樣加密。

items.title: DNSSEC：簽章與信任鏈
items.body: 驗證經簽署的 DNS 資料，不驗證網站功能。

items.title: 區域傳送
items.body: 使用存取控制與 TSIG 保護授權／完整性；TSIG 不會加密區域內容。

visual.caption: Three DNS mechanisms: efficiency, data authentication and transport privacy
visual.description: The three cards are parallel comparisons. Arrows below show a simplified lookup path. DoH/DoT protect a particular link; DNSSEC validates signatures and a trust chain, rather than encrypting the entire resolution path.

items.title: Cache
items.body: Speeds repeated queries without always contacting authoritative DNS. Does not prove a particular user visited a website.

items.title: DNSSEC
items.body: Authenticates signed DNS data and its integrity. Does not guarantee query confidentiality or website health.

items.title: Encrypted DNS: DoH / DoT
items.body: Protects a particular client-to-resolver transport link. The resolver still learns and processes the query.

items.title: Your computer | Stub Resolver
items.body: Sends a DNS query

items.title: Recursive Resolver
items.body: May validate DNSSEC or use cached data

items.title: Authoritative DNS data
items.body: Supplies records according to zone configuration

items.title: Client ↔ resolver: DoH / DoT
items.body: Encrypts this transport link; later links need not use the same encryption.

items.title: DNSSEC: signatures and trust chain
items.body: Validates signed DNS data, not website functions.

items.title: Zone transfer
items.body: Access control and TSIG protect authorization / integrity. TSIG does not encrypt zone contents.
